summary: Iterates every vehicle slot and resolves the AI settings (.svm) file path for each active vehicle. When per-vehicle AI settings mode is enabled (byte_7D03E0), builds a candidate path from the vehicle's directory, the resolved settings folder, a qual/race segment chosen by session type, and the .svm extension, tries up to three file variants, and stores the first that opens into the vehicle at +18324. In default mode it copies the globally resolved default path instead. Returns the loop counter.

operations.description: Resolve the default AI settings directory into the 128-byte local buffer via AISettingsFileResolver.
Initialize the loop counter to 0 and read the vehicle count bound from global dword_5C329C.
Iterate over every vehicle slot, fetching each vehicle pointer from the global vehicle-pointer array dword_7C54F0 until the counter reaches the vehicle count.
Skip a vehicle whose dword at +13000 is zero (inactive slot).
When global byte_7D03E0 (per-vehicle AI settings mode) is zero, fall through to the default-mode path that copies the resolved default path.
Zero the out-string slot v14[0], copy the vehicle's directory string at +18196 via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, and fall back to byte_5EA438 when the copy yields an empty string.
Trim trailing backslash characters (ASCII 92) from the copied directory string by scanning backward from the last character.
Compute the resulting string length through NullSafePointerDereference and, when the string does not already end in a backslash, append the backslash separator word_5C2AAC via sub_5665B0.
Resolve the settings folder from the global settings-file path dword_7CE5EC (falling back to byte_5EA438 when empty) via SettingsFolderResolver.
Re-copy the vehicle directory string, then append the resolved settings folder, the session segment and the .svm extension (aSvm) by concatenation helper sub_5665B0.
Select the qualifying segment aQual when IterationCountMap(dword_7C56A4) equals 5, otherwise select the race segment aRace_1.
Attempt to open the assembled path in read mode (aR) via sub_587DB0; when it opens, close it with FileCloseWithLock and run SafeStringCopy(255), then jump to the cleanup path.
When the first candidate fails to open, retry with the alternate candidate built from the directory plus .svm, and then the directory plus the fallback segment aAiSvm plus .svm.
On a successfully opened candidate, close the file and copy the final path into the vehicle at +18324 via sub_587DD0, then clear the flag byte at +18579.
Free the temporary directory string with FreeWrapper_7bcf on every exit path when it was allocated.
In default mode (byte_7D03E0 == 0), copy the resolved default AI settings path from the local v18 buffer into the vehicle at +18324 and clear the flag byte at +18579.
Return the loop counter (the final incremented index) after processing all vehicles.

clean_pseudocode: char* alt = StrDup(dir, NULL); Append(alt, folder); Append(alt, aSvm);
char* alt2 = StrDup(dir, NULL); Append(alt2, aAiSvm);
unresolved: Exact meaning of the vehicle dword at +13000 used as the active-slot guard.
Meaning of the flag byte cleared at +18579 after a path is stored.
Why IterationCountMap(dword_7C56A4) == 5 selects the qualifying segment.
Semantics of SafeStringCopy(255) on the successful-open path.
